verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents local, in-memory evaluation in client On-Device Eval SDKs and in server SDKs. Nothing mentions evaluating flags at the edge, such as in CDN workers or through an edge or relay proxy layer. Local SDK evaluation is a related but different capability and does not show edge delivery, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can evaluate flags at the edge (CDN workers or an edge/relay layer) close to users
